# Experience Intake

Complete what you know. Short notes are enough.

```yaml
working_title: ""
when_it_happened: ""
situation: ""
challenge: ""
what_i_did: ""
what_happened_next: ""
what_i_learned: ""
audience: "" # practitioners | leaders-hiring-managers | help-me-choose
desired_conversation: ""
image_paths: []
video_paths: []
reference_urls: []
company_tag_requests: [] # company name and public LinkedIn Page URL
media_permissions_confirmed: false
sensitive_details_to_hide: []
facts_i_am_unsure_about: []
```

## Minimum Required Detail

Before drafting, establish:

- One concrete situation or tension.
- One action the user personally took.
- One observed outcome, even if it was inconclusive.
- One lesson that follows from the experience.
- One intended audience.

## Optional Publishing Material

- Share local image or video paths to attach. State whether you have permission to publish every person, screen, document, logo, and location shown.
- Share a source URL when it supports a claim or gives useful further reading. It is not evidence unless its relevance is verified.
- For a requested company tag, provide the company name and public LinkedIn Page URL. A tag is requested for the publishing handoff; do not write `@Company` into draft text as a substitute.

Ask no more than three questions at a time. Offer answer choices when that reduces effort. Do not force the user to complete every optional field.
